Llm._Provider: Allowed values: "OpenAI" | "NvidiaNim" | "Azure" | "Anthropic" | "Bedrock" — selects the chat/vision provider and which section below supplies its config

Azure._Comment: BaseUrl is the Azure OpenAI resource endpoint; ChatModel/EmbeddingModel are deployment names, not model names

Anthropic._Comment: Chat and vision only — Anthropic has no embeddings API; set Embeddings:Provider to a different provider

Bedrock._Comment: Chat, vision, and embeddings via AWS SigV4 auth (no ApiKey — uses the host's AWS credential chain)

Embeddings._Provider: Optional. Set to a different provider (OpenAI | NvidiaNim | Azure | Bedrock) when Llm:Provider lacks an embeddings API (Anthropic). Defaults to Llm:Provider.

Gateway._Comment: graphify's own semantic-extraction backend only supports gemini|kimi|claude|openai|deepseek|ollama — not Bedrock or Azure directly. Required only when Llm:Provider is Azure or Bedrock: front it with an OpenAI-compatible gateway (e.g. LiteLLM) and point graphify at that gateway.
